hints.title: Contiguous Block Shifting
hints.text: A one can leap over any contiguous segment of zeros in a single operation. Every preceding one can leap over this block.

hints.title: Zero Segment Triggers
hints.text: Whenever we reach a zero segment, every one accumulated so far will eventually leap over this zero segment.

hints.title: Linear Accumulation
hints.text: Count ones as you scan left to right. Each time a transition into a block of zeros is detected, add the count of ones seen so far to the total.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: n: length of binary string s
complexity.notes: Single linear traversal through the string.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating individual shifts is quadratic O(n^2).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Groups consecutive zeros and computes accumulated shifts in a single pass.
